notes.title: Axis Football 2017 v3.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, folks!

First, I owe everyone an apology for the v3.0 update. The crashes and stability issues were totally my fault. I didn't test well enough, and a lot of you were simply unable to play the game for about a week. That's unacceptable, and I've put policies and procedures in place to make sure that doesn't happen again.

Second, I'm happy to report that after a ton of digging (and coffee), the team was able to find and fix the problems. Axis Football 2017 v3.3 is now live on Steam and should have the crashes fixed. 

Third, if you are still experiencing issues with Franchise Mode not loading correctly (or your game does happen to crash), please send the Output_Log.txt file directly to my email address: danny@axisgamesonline.com.

You can find the output log here: 

C:\Users\<your user name>\AppData\LocalLow\Axis Games\Axis Football 2017

Finally, if you happened to have purchsed the game in the past week, I owe you an additional apology on top of the first. Your inital experience with the game should not have been a frustrating attempt to play a game that you paid money for. So, I am truly sorry for that. Our users and fans are extremely important to us, and it is not our habit to release unplayable, unstable, or overly buggy games. You deserve better than that.

I will wrap up by humbly requesting that any negative reviews made as a result of the v3.0 update be reconsidered if the new version is a game that you would recommend to friends. Ratings and reviews are a driving force for sales, and those are very important to us as we attempt to reinvest and improve the Axis Football series.

Thanks for all the support,

Danny Jugan

notes.title: Axis Football 2017 v1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, folks!

We just pushed a patch for Axis Football 2017. This was not a content update, but we did fix a few bugs and gameplay issues that popped up.

Patch Notes:

[list]
    [*]Fixed the bug where certain player's routes/instructions were not properly flipping when the user flips a play
    [*]Fixed the stadium preview images to properly match their stadium
    [*]Fixed the bug where punt returners were often not catching the punt
    [*]Fixed the bug with the player editor where the name was not getting saved
    [*]Game options like difficulty, quarter length, and player fatigue on/off will now be saved to each franchise so users won't have to set those each game.
    [*]Reduced the effectiveness of D Line power and finesse moves.
    [*]Reduced the likelihood of interceptions
[/list]


Our next update will include new content and features. You can expect it to release in about two weeks!

Happy gaming,

Danny Jugan
Lead Developer, Axis Games
